title: Name/secure blocking reviewers (Data&licensing, domain, educator)
context: Three blocking reviewer roles must be filled before the M0 pilot module can be reviewed and called done: a Data & licensing reviewer (mandatory gatekeeper for any dataset use), a domain reviewer (cancer bioinformatics, confirms technical correctness and no biological/clinical claim is presented as a finding), and an educator reviewer (confirms learning-objective alignment, assessment validity, and accessibility). Without named reviewers in these roles, the pilot review cannot be scheduled. Until filled, all dataset-touching tasks carry verifiedNeed: false and no example can pass the data gate.
objective: Identify and secure named commitments from the three blocking reviewer roles — Data & licensing, domain (cancer bioinformatics), and educator — required for the project, and document them in a GOVERNANCE.md file committed to the repo.
acceptanceCriteria: Data & licensing reviewer named: can read open-data/genomics licenses, apply open/aggregate/de-identified + permits-derivatives + identifiability criteria; role is non-skippable gatekeeper. Name, affiliation, and confirmation committed.

Domain reviewer (cancer bioinformatics) named: can verify technical correctness of worked examples and confirm no biological/clinical conclusion is presented as a finding or advice. Name, affiliation, and confirmation committed.

Educator reviewer named: can verify Bloom-aligned learning-objective alignment, assessment construct validity, cognitive load for non-computational scientists, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility. Name, affiliation, and confirmation committed.
GOVERNANCE.md committed to the project repo listing all three reviewer roles with names/affiliations; DCO signed off.
All three reviewers confirmed before the M0 pilot module review is scheduled (blocking prerequisite).
resources: The Carpentries instructor community (potential educator reviewer source)
Cancer-center bioinformatics cores (potential domain reviewer source)
ELIXIR / Bioinformatics training networks (potential reviewer source)
output: GOVERNANCE.md committed to the project repo, listing the three blocking reviewer roles with named individuals, affiliations, and role descriptions; confirmation of all three roles filled before the M0 pilot review.
